8 إِنْتَفَجَا حَنْبَا البَعِيرِ The sides of the camel became elevated, (S, K,) [or bulging,] and great, naturally. (TA.) ―
-b2- Hence the expression إِنْتِفَاجُ الأَهِلَّةِ (assumed tropical:) [The swelling out of the new moons], in a trad. respecting the signs [of the last day]. (TA.) ―
-b3- See 1 throughout.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
